topics.summary: Explosions struck four oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns about global energy security.
Putin adopted a firm stance in US talks, while Ukraine reported new Starlink disruptions, escalating global tensions.
A Brooklyn building collapse tragically killed eight people, including two children, prompting an urgent investigation.
Nasdaq declined as Nvidia shares fell after its CEO's exit, compounded by rising global oil prices.
Thousands reported Microsoft Outlook issues, disrupting communication for many users globally.
Russell Brand faces new allegations of misconduct, further impacting his career and public image.

A hacker called me. He said he had all my passwords. I said, “Hold on. I’m getting a pen.”

items.explanation: The victim's forgetfulness makes them ask the hacker for their own passwords.

items.joke: Algorithm: A word used by programmers when they don't want to explain how their code works.

idiom.title: Touch and go
idiom.glossZh: “危险的” 或 “情况不确定的”。
idiom.interpretationEn: This phrase originates from aviation terminology, where “touch and go” describes a maneuver where an aircraft briefly touches down on the runway and immediately takes off again. It is often used to describe situations that are perilous or highly uncertain.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语源自于飞行术语，其中 “touch and go” 描述的是飞机在跑道上短暂停留然后立即起飞的动作。这种情况经常用来形容比较危险或者结果非常不确定的事情。

examples.en: It was touch and go for a while after the surgery.
examples.zh: 在手术之后，有段时间情况非常不稳定。

examples.en: The rescue mission was touch and go due to the severe weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣的天气条件，救援任务非常危险。

examples.en: It’s touch and go whether the company will survive the financial crisis.
examples.zh: 公司是否能渡过财务危机还是个未知数。

people.name: Jeanne Mance
people.bio: 17th-century French nurse and settler in Quebec, New France
people.extract: Jeanne Mance was a French nurse and settler of New France. She arrived in New France two years after the Ursuline nuns came to Quebec. Among the founders of Montreal in 1642, she established its first hospital, the Hotel-Dieu de Montreal, in 1645. She returned twice to France to seek financial support for the hospital. After providing most of the care directly for years, in 1657 she recruited three sisters of the Religieuses hospitalieres de Saint-Joseph and continued to direct operations of the hospital. During her era, she was also known as Jehanne Mance by the French, and as Joan Mance by the English.
highlights: French nurse and settler of New France.
Established Montreal's first hospital, Hotel-Dieu de Montreal.

people.name: Jorge Masvidal
people.extract: Jorge Luis Masvidal is an American professional boxer and former professional mixed martial artist who competed in the Welterweight and Lightweight divisions. He competed professionally for 20 years from 2003 until 2023, having fought in the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), Bellator, Strikeforce, Shark Fights, and World Victory Road. Masvidal holds the record for the fastest knockout in UFC history at five seconds, and won the symbolic UFC "BMF" title.
highlights: American professional boxer and former MMA artist.
Holds record for fastest UFC knockout at five seconds.

people.name: Harry Blackmun
people.bio: US Supreme Court justice from 1970 to 1994
people.extract: Harold Andrew Blackmun was an American lawyer and jurist who served as an associate justice of the Supreme Court of the United States from 1970 to 1994. Appointed by President Richard Nixon, Blackmun ultimately became one of the most liberal justices on the Court. He is best known as the author of the Court's opinion in Roe v. Wade.
highlights: Associate Justice of the Supreme Court (1970-1994).
Author of the Court's opinion in Roe v. Wade.
